description: Pre-traffic scan of the live site (read-only: no form posts): clicks what looks clickable, checks links and errors, and returns the one worst defect it can reproduce 3 of 3 times. Results are labelled as a scan, not visitor behaviour. Takes 1-3 minutes. Free, 10 a day per site.

url.description: Page to start from; defaults to the site's home page

name: scan_site
